reason: I already have an Echo that does alarm and weather, and a smart alarm is not my problem. My problem is scrolling before sleep, and a nice wooden box will not stop me taking my phone to bed.
objection: It costs 120 euros to do what my Echo and my phone already do. Pre-ordering from a brand I have never heard of, for a batch that does not exist yet, makes that worse. The sleep and snoring estimate is the part I would trust least.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the finished product in a real review from someone independent, and a clear, honest account of how the sleep estimate is made. A lower price, around 80 to 90 euros, would also help.
